title: Recent Overpayment Notices and the Plan Down Payment — Network Participation Agreements
content:
Under the **Network Participation Agreements**, when an agreement has drawn several overpayment notices in recent months, a down payment to place its open overpayments in a repayment plan is raised.

**Clause.** The down payment recent-notice points are set by the agreement's overpayment notices dated fewer than 6 whole months before today:

- three or more add 10 percentage points to the down payment percentage;
- exactly two add 5 percentage points;
- fewer than two add nothing.

The down payment percentage is the percentage at which the down payment base is taken.

## Counting

- Count every overpayment notice on the agreement whose notice date is fewer than 6 whole months before today, whatever has since happened to it.
- Whole months are the difference in calendar months from the notice date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the notice date's day of the month.

## Hypothetical cases

| Notices on the agreement | Within 6 whole months | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 1 | Nothing |
| 3 | 2 | 5 |
| 5 | 3 | 10 |
